title: Dark Matter
author: Blake Crouch
summary: A Chicago physics professor is taken at gunpoint one evening and wakes up in a life that is eerily different from his own. He must find a way back to his wife and son through a maze of alternate versions of himself.
readIf: you want a page-turner with parallel worlds, a ticking clock and a love story at its heart.
skipIf: you want detailed, rigorous science, as the story favours speed and twists over exact explanation.

pairings.reason: The same author, with a similar mix of a science idea and a race against time.
A softer take on what a different life might have looked like, with more reflection and less danger.
